summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a routine rotation of its president role. Xu Chen ceased as president on September 1, 2026, remaining an executive director and resuming as Chief Marketing Officer. Tao Zhang was appointed rotating president for a one-year term ending August 31, 2027, while continuing as CTO. No financial terms, shareholder actions, or strategic transactions are involved; this is a governance and organizational efficiency update. The filing is not a special situation, and no further corporate action or risk-arbitrage angle applies.
